text: 🎬 Soderbergh takes the Batcowl behind the camera Steven Soderbergh has stepped in to finish shooting 'The Batman Part II', and Matt Reeves plans to return for post-production. The details are thin so far. Soderbergh is a fast, practical shooter who often works as his own cinematographer. That's a useful skill when a big production needs to wrap efficiently. Nothing so far says Robert Pattinson 's return is in doubt. If Reeves keeps the edit, the score and the final look, the film will still read as his Gotham, and Soderbergh will have been a clean-up hitter.

🍿 'Clayface' turns Gotham's mud man into body horror, and early reactions like it 📆 Release: October 23, 2026 🎭 Genre: #Horror · #Superhero ✈️ Add to watchlist James Watkins (the man behind 'Eden Lake' and 'Speak No Evil') directs an R-rated Batman spin-off, and /Film has the first screening reactions in. That's a filmmaker who knows how to make cruelty uncomfortable, which suits a villain whose body is the horror. The script comes from Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, so expect a tragic monster story, not a capes-and-quips one. Tom Rhys Harries as Matt Hagen has to sell both the charm and the melting. Social reactions are always generous, so the real test is the full reviews. The cast also includes Naomi Ackie and David Dencik.

🍿 Gerwig's Narnia starts with a lion singing the world into being 📆 Release: February 12, 2027 (theaters), April 2 on Netflix 🎭 Genre: #Fantasy · #Adventure ✈️ Add to watchlist We have the first trailer for 'The Magician's Nephew', with two newcomers as Digory and Polly, Daniel Craig and Meryl Streep in support, and Led Zeppelin's "Stairway to Heaven" over the first steps into another world. Picking the creation story is a smart way into Narnia. It skips the wardrobe and the Pevensies, and it lets Greta Gerwig play with myth and wonder, as she did with the plastic utopia of 'Barbie' . A classic-rock needle drop says she isn't making a museum piece.
